rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a large sea or ocean.

example.english: I've always wanted to go to the ocean to watch the sunset.
example.traditional: 我一直都想去大海睇日落。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 soeng2 heoi3 daai6 hoi2 tai2 jat6 lok6

rows.note: Use this mainly for a geographically defined ocean as one of the large bodies separating continents.

example.english: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world.
example.traditional: 太平洋係世界上最大嘅大洋。
example.jyutping: taai3 ping4 joeng4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 daai6 joeng4

rows.note: Use this when you mean the water itself rather than the body of water.

example.english: The ocean water here is freezing cold.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 hoi2 seoi2 dung3 dou3 jap6 gwat1

rows.note: Use this mainly in written or literary metaphors for an apparently boundless expanse.

example.english: This book leads me into an ocean of knowledge.
example.traditional: 呢本書帶我走進知識嘅海洋。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 daai3 ngo5 zau2 zeon3 zi1 sik1 ge3 hoi2 joeng4
